discovery_note: Ternary ⟨2,2,2⟩=7 base realising a recombination multiset not otherwise in the catalog. At a 2-part split (n₁≥n₂ per axis) the sub-shape multiset is 3·⟨n₁,m₁,p₁⟩ + 1·⟨n₁,m₂,p₂⟩ + 1·⟨n₂,m₁,p₂⟩ + 1·⟨n₂,m₂,p₁⟩ + 1·⟨n₂,m₂,p₂⟩. Concretely at (9,8)³ → ⟨17,17,17⟩: 1·⟨8,8,8⟩ + 1·⟨8,8,9⟩ + 1·⟨8,9,8⟩ + 1·⟨9,8,8⟩ + 3·⟨9,9,9⟩. Of independent interest: the 3×⟨n₁,n₁,n₁⟩ cubic group admits 3-way trilinear aggregation (Pan), a cost lever Strassen's own multiset does not expose. Found by exact GL₂(ℚ)³-orbit enumeration (Ternary2x2x2Orbit / RecombinationMultisetOrbit); de Groote-equivalent to Strassen.
